description.text: Copies stamped with the Pokémon Card Gym logo, given at Pokémon Card Gyms, the game and hobby shops across Japan that host official play. Most here are Mega Evolution promos of 2026: Shaymin, Mega Delphox ex, Seel, Spritzee, Grisham and Dawn in Pokémon Card Gym Promo Card Pack 4, handed out in one-card and two-card packs from 1 May 2026, and Wimpod, Mega Tatsugiri ex, Tynamo, Patrat, Special Red Card, Lida and Boss's Orders in Pack 5 from 1 August 2026. Pikachu 133/M-P, with the World Championships logo, was a participation prize at Pokémon Card Gym events from 20 June 2026, and Eevee 134/M-P the participation prize of the Deck As Is Battle events from 2 September 2026. The Pokémon Card Gym Entry Campaign, from 1 September 2026 to 28 February 2027, gave Lillie's Determination 145/M-P for two digital stamps and Mega Audino ex 146/M-P for four. Pack 6, from 1 November 2026, holds Golett, Hariyama, Gastly, Mega Heatran ex, Energy Recycler, Lebanne and Gwynn.
